description: Croatian company annual-accounts filings recorded at the Sudski registar (daily snapshot): per financial year, the filing type (GFI-POD report, statement of inactivity, statement of correction), consolidation flag, period covered and filing date, newest first; metadata only, never the document. `aucun_depot: true` is a measured fact. A sole trader (trgovac pojedinac, t.p.) or an undecided legal form returns 404, not billed; so does a name covered by an objection. Paid via x402 ($0.01 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

oib.description: 11-digit Croatian OIB (e.g. 92803032010); an 8- or 9-digit MBS court-register number is accepted too

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_croatian_company_accounts

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.

title: Croatian company annual-accounts filings
